Weakness Name: OpenSSH signal handler race condition (regreSSHion) remote code execution
Remediation Plan: Upgrade OpenSSH to the vendor-patched package.
Downgrade or upgrade xz-utils to a vendor-fixed release and rebuild the host.

Weakness Name: curl SOCKS5 proxy handshake heap buffer overflow
Remediation Plan: Upgrade curl and libcurl to the vendor-patched package.

Weakness Name: libwebp heap buffer overflow in container image
Deviation Rationale: The portal never decodes WebP images: uploads are restricted to PDF and JPEG at the API layer and the vulnerable library is only a transitive dependency of the base image. Exploitation requires attacker-supplied WebP input, which cannot reach the library.
Remediation Plan: Rebuild the image on a base with the patched libwebp package.
Comments: DR-001 risk adjusted High to Moderate, approved 2026-07-21

Weakness Name: OpenSSL BN_mod_sqrt() infinite loop denial of service
Deviation Rationale: The scanner matched on the OpenSSL version string. The vendor build on this host includes the back-ported fix, confirmed by the vendor advisory and the package changelog.
Strict key exchange is enabled on the bastion; the scanner flags any host that offers ChaCha20-Poly1305 without checking for the strict-kex extension.
Remediation Plan: Enable strict key exchange or disable ChaCha20-Poly1305 and Encrypt-then-MAC modes.

Weakness Name: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 enabled on partner integration listener
Deviation Rationale: One state partner's case-management system can only negotiate TLS 1.1. The listener is limited to that partner's two source IPs by WAF rule, and the partner has committed to an upgrade in Q1 2027.
Remediation Plan: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1; require TLS 1.2 or higher.
Comments: DR-003 operational requirement approved 2026-07-28; reassess by 2027-01-28

Remediation Plan: Require SMB signing through Group Policy.

Weakness Name: SSH server allows CBC mode ciphers
Remediation Plan: Remove CBC ciphers from the sshd Ciphers list.

Weakness Name: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset denial of service
Remediation Plan: Apply the appliance vendor's firmware fix when released.
Comments: vendor Northwind Networks (load balancer appliance) ticket NWN-58123; last check-in 2026-08-28; mitigated to Moderate on 2026-08-19

Weakness Name: Inventoried asset not reached by the monthly scan
Remediation Plan: Confirm the asset is powered on and reachable with credentials, then rescan.

Weakness Name: Scanned asset missing from the system inventory
Remediation Plan: Add the asset to the inventory with an owner, or decommission it.
